inventory.notes: Two new members of a chrome-only dictionary. jugglerEventId is Juggler plumbing (consumed at nsDOMWindowUtils.cpp:762 and nsContentUtils.cpp:10517). latency (ms before dispatch) sets the event birth time: nsDOMWindowUtils.cpp:765 stores it in mLatency and :897-898 uses nsContentUtils::InputEventBirth(aLatency) for the timestamp, which a page reads as event.timeStamp. [verified: the dictionary is reachable only from chrome, synthesizeMouseEvent is [ChromeOnly, Throws], Window.webidl:649.] Comment cites internal bug B299. If the series is split by category, jugglerEventId belongs in the Juggler patch.

verifier.why: Mixed file: latency is consumed by nsDOMWindowUtils.cpp (InputEventBirth, event timestamps a page can read) so the stealth part is a spoof; jugglerEventId is plain automation plumbing.
